steps.title: LOGIN

input.description: XXX represents the user initials. All user actions are terminated with a carriage return; designated by the key marked RETURN on the terminal.

steps.response: XXX (N) LOGGED IN AT HR'MN  MMDDYY. N is the terminal location number; HR and MN is the time the user entered the system in hours and minutes; and MMDDYY is the month, day, and year. This login allows user XXX to access any of the active programs on the SPADS system.

steps.title: PROGRAM ENTRY
prompt: THE FOLLOWING IS A LIST OF CURRENT APPLICATIONS
PLEASE INDICATE YOUR APPLICATION/PROJECT BY SELECTING THE APPROPRIATE KEY

input.description: After system LOGIN is completed, the user must specify the program selection MAIL LOG.

steps.response: MAIL

steps.title: DATA BASE SUBFILE SELECTION
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO WORK WITH THE DIR/REPORT DATA --- ENTER DIR

input.description: In order for the user to select one of the four modes of operation, one of three main data base subfiles must first be designated. To leave the program the user must enter QUIT TWICE (section 2.3).

steps.title: MODE SELECTION
prompt: PLEASE CHOSE ONE OF THE FOLLOWING

input.description: Select one of the four modes of operation. To leave the program the user must enter QUIT TWICE (section 2.3).

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: IS THIS A CONTINUATION OF INPUT (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #2
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO START A NEW ENTRY (NEW)

input.description: Start a new entry, spool last output again, or spool new data entered

branches.when: Last, output spooled to printer. Exit input mode

steps.title: Step #3
prompt: STAND BY.  SYSTEM NOW PERFORMING FILE HOUSEKEEPING.
steps.response: System pauses 10 to 35 seconds. No user response required.

steps.title: Step #4
prompt: WELCOME TO THE MAIL LOG FILE INPUT ROUTINE.
PLEASE NOTE THAT ALL ENTRIES ARE TO BE PLACED BETWEEN THE
EXCLAMATION MARKS AND SHOULD BE LEFT JUSTIFIED
FIRST - PLEASE ENTER THE CURRENT DATE

input.description: Input desired date for daily input - month, day, and year. Note: User must skip a space to start.

steps.title: Step #7
steps.response: If legal entry, entry displayed on terminal. This is done for all entries to follow.

steps.title: Step #14
steps.response: Note: This date will automatically be entered from the current date earlier and be displayed on terminal

steps.title: Step #15
steps.response: If this W.A. number is found in the contract table, the contract number will be automatically entered and displayed on the terminal.

branches.when: W.A. number found in contract table

steps.title: Step #16
prompt: IS THERE A CONTRACT NUMBER FOR THIS DOCUMENT (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #19
prompt: HOW MANY REFERENCE NUMBERS ARE THERE (MAX OF 6)

input.description: Enter number X. (12) REFERENCED DOCUMENT NUMBER (18 characters, Figure 3) repeated X number of times

steps.title: Step #21
prompt: HOW MANY NASA RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER(S) ARE THERE (MAX OF 3)

input.description: Enter number X. (14) RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER(S), 3 characters - 3 entries (Figure 3)

steps.title: Step #22
prompt: HOW MANY DESCRIPTIONS ARE TO BE ENTERED (MAX OF 30)

input.description: Enter number X. (15) DESCRIPTION OF DOCUMENT TRANSMITTED repeated X number of times. Description is only used in the transmittal subfile (Figure 3).

steps.title: Step #23
prompt: CHECK RECORD FOR ERRORS: IF CORRECT, ENTER COR
steps.response: Entire record displayed on terminal

steps.title: Step #24
prompt: HOW MANY ITEMS DO YOU WISH TO REVISE (MAX OF 14)

steps.title: Step #25
prompt: INPUT THE ITEM NUMBER THAT YOU WISH TO REVISE

input.description: Enter number NN. Repeat XX number of times

steps.response: Branches to data item to be revised, then returns to #23

steps.title: Step #26
prompt: WHICH SUB-FILE IS THIS RECORD TO BE STORED (NUMBER)

steps.title: Step #27
prompt: STAND BY.  SYSTEM NOW IN AUTOMATIC UPDATE MODE
steps.response: If referenced document field is blank, go to #30. If not blank, the following message is displayed: STAND BY. SYSTEM NOW IN AUTOMATIC UPDATE MODE

branches.when: Word delay or delayed is found in the subject
Approval, approved, disapproved, disapproval, or disposition of the above

steps.title: Step #29
prompt: ENTER NEW DUE DATE (IF NONE, REPEAT OLD DATE)

input.description: MMDDYY represents the old date actual displayed month, day, and year

steps.title: Step #30
prompt: FURTHER DATA TO BE INPUT (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #31
prompt: DO YOU DESIRE THE DAILY OUTPUT (NOW OR WAIT)

steps.title: Step #32
prompt: WILL YOU WANT A COMPLETE DATA PRINTOUT ALONG WITH THE DAILY

input.description: Complete data printout along with the daily brief office output

branches.when: Yes, formats and spools both complete and brief outputs to the high speed printer
No, formats and spools only the brief output to the high speed printer

steps.title: Step #33
steps.response: Exit from the input mode

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: PLEASE ENTER THE INPUT DATE AND COUNT CODE OF THE DOCUMENT

input.description: Input date and daily counter code of the document; the unique identifier for its location (input date 6 characters - MMDDYY, daily counter 4 characters, Figure 3)

steps.title: Step #2
prompt: IS THIS A SPECIAL ACTION DUE SUBFILE REQUEST

steps.title: Step #3
prompt: HOW MANY SUBFILES DO YOU WISH TO OPEN

steps.title: Step #4
prompt: DO YOU WANT SUBFILE NUMBER N (YES OR NO)

input.description: Where N is file number 1 thru 6. Repeated until X number of files designated

steps.title: Step #5
prompt: IS THIS THE CORRECT RECORD TO BE REVISED OR DELETED (YES OR NO)

input.description: Document displayed on terminal when found

steps.response: Document displayed on terminal when found

branches.when: No, continue search for document. When found repeat Step #5

steps.title: Step #6
prompt: IS THIS RECORD TO BE REVISED OR DELETED (REV. OR DEL)

branches.when: Del, record deleted; exit revise mode
Action due file previously selected in Step #2

steps.title: Step #8
prompt: HOW MANY ITEMS DO YO WISH TO REVISE (MAX OF 14)

steps.title: Step #9
prompt: INPUT THE ITEM NUMBER THAT YOU WISH TO REVISE.

input.description: Enter number NN. Repeat XX number of times. Branch to data item NN to be revised. See input mode (4.1.1.2 Steps #6 thru #22).

branches.when: Branch to data item NN to be revised (input mode Steps #6 thru #22)

steps.title: Step #10

input.description: Entire record displayed on terminal. Check record for errors: If correct, enter COR; If revision needed, enter REV

steps.response: Entire record displayed on terminal.

steps.title: Step #12
steps.response: Exit from REVISE mode after brief pause to update file

steps.title: Step #13
steps.response: Exit from REVISE mode after brief pause to update file

steps.title: Step #14
steps.response: Exit from REVISE mode after brief pause to update file

steps.title: Step #15
steps.response: Exit from REVISE mode after brief pause to update file

steps.title: Step #16
steps.response: Exit from REVISE mode after brief pause to update file

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: YOU ARE NOW VALIDATED TO SEARCH DATA IN THE MAIL LOG FILE -
THE FOLLOWING SEARCH MODES ARE AVAILABLE FOR YOUR USE -

steps.title: Step #2
steps.response: No user response

branches.when: DOC, IDD, ADD, or ALL selected for key

steps.title: Step #4
prompt: WHAT IS THE FIRST VALID DATE

steps.title: Step #5
prompt: WHAT IS THE LAST VALID DATE

steps.title: Step #6
steps.response: If not legal, the following message is displayed: ERROR IN DATES - PLEASE TRY AGAIN

branches.when: Not legal: ERROR IN DATES - PLEASE TRY AGAIN

steps.title: Step #7
steps.response: No user response. Continue to #8

steps.title: Step #8
prompt: HOW MANY SUBFILES DO YOU WISH TO OPEN

input.description: Enter number X to be searched

steps.title: Step #9
prompt: DO YOU WANT SUBFILE NUMBER N (YES OR NO)

input.description: Where N is file number 1 thru 6. Repeated until X number of files designated

steps.title: Step #11
prompt: THIS IS THE ACTION ITEM DUE DATE ROUTINE
NOTE - BREAK KEY HAS BEEN DISABLED FOR THIS RUN
THERE ARE TWO (2) OPTIONS FOR THE ACTION DUE SEARCH
1. A COMPLETE LISTING OF ALL ACTION DUE (1)
2. A NORMAL WITHIN 5 DAYS OR PAST DUE (2)

steps.title: Step #12
steps.response: If none found, the following message is displayed: THERE ARE NO DOCUMENTS AWAITING ACTION / IF YOU WISH TO CONTINUE, DEPRESS THE RETURN. If documents are found, a header is displayed. Document data then follows. See Figure 37. After the last document is found and displayed, the following message is written on the terminal: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS AWAITING ACTION. Where XXX represents the number found, the output is spooled, exit search mode. See Figure 38.

branches.when: None found; when return key is used
Documents found; after the last, the output is spooled, exit search mode

steps.title: Step #13
prompt: THIS IS THE PRINT ALL ROUTINE
ALL DOCUMENTS IN THE MAIL LOG FILE WILL BE PRINTED

steps.title: Step #14
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 15. The output file is spooled. See Figure 16. Exit search mode.

steps.title: Step #15
prompt: WHO IS THE NASA RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER

steps.title: Step #16
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER OF AAA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 17. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAA are is initials entered for search

steps.title: Step #17
prompt: IF YOU WISH TO CONTINUE, DEPRESS THE RETURN KEY

steps.title: Step #18
prompt: THIS IS THE WHO TO/ADDRESSEE SEARCH

input.description: Enter name AAAA up to 32 characters. Last name, comma, space, first initial, period, space, middle initial, period.

steps.title: Step #19
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH AN ADDRESSEE OF AAAA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 19. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAAA the addressee entered for search

steps.title: Step #21
prompt: WHAT IS THE DATE THAT YOU WANT

steps.title: Step #22
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A DOCUMENT DATE OF MM-DD-YY
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 21. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and MMDDYY is the document date entered for search.

input.description: Enter contract number AAAA up to 20 characters

steps.title: Step #25
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A CONTRACT NUMBER OF AAAA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 23. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAAA is the contract number entered for search.

input.description: Enter W.A. No. NNNN and ID Code IIII

steps.title: Step #28
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A W.A. NUMBER/ID CODE OF NNNNIIII.
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 25. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and NNNNIIII is the W.A. number/ID code entered for search.

steps.title: Step #30
prompt: THIS IS THE DOCUMENT AUTHOR/SOURCE SEARCH

input.description: Enter Author/Source AAAA up to 28 characters. Note: Author - last name, space, first initial, period, space middle initial, period.

steps.title: Step #31
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH AN AUTHOR/SOURCE OF AAAA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 27. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAAA is the author/source entered for search

steps.title: Step #33
prompt: WHAT IS THE DESIRED DOCUMENT NUMBER

input.description: Enter document number AAAA up to 18 characters

steps.title: Step #34
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH DOCUMENT/LETTER NUMBER OF AAAA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 29. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAAA is the document number entered for search.

steps.title: Step #36
prompt: WHAT IS THE DATE THAT YOU WANT

steps.title: Step #37
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A DATE OF MM-DD-YY
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 31. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and MMDDYY is the input date entered for search.

steps.title: Step #39
prompt: HOW MANY WORDS DO YOU WISH TO MATCH (MAX OF 4)

steps.title: Step #41
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS CONTAINING THE WORD AAAA
steps.response: As each subject is found containing the desired word, the subject is displayed on the terminal. Following the last subject is displayed a message. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AAAA is the desired word entered.

steps.title: Step #42
steps.response: Steps #40 and #41 are repeated X number of times from Step #39, unless zero (0) documents are found. If no documents are found, go to #45.

branches.when: Repeated X number of times from Step #39

steps.title: Step #43
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed after the last word is searched. See Figure 33.

steps.title: Step #45
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO TRY THE SUBJECT SEARCH AGAIN (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #46
prompt: THIS IS THE MAIL STATUS SEARCH ROUTINE
PLEASE INPUT THE DESIRED MAIL STATUS

input.description: Enter mail status AA: Vought Correspondence, Incoming Mail, or Outgoing Mail

steps.title: Step #47
steps.response: If AA not legal, message displayed: ERROR IN MAIL STATUS AA NOT ALLOWABLE. TRY AGAIN. Where AA is the mail status entered, go to #46.

branches.when: AA not legal: ERROR IN MAIL STATUS AA NOT ALLOWABLE. TRY AGAIN

steps.title: Step #48
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DOCUMENTS WITH A MAIL STATUS OF AA
steps.response: A header followed by document data is displayed. See Figure 35. Terminal message is displayed after last found. Where XXX represents the number of documents found and AA is the mail status entered for search

steps.title: Step #50
prompt: DO YOU WANT A HARD COPY OF THE INFORMATION FOUND

input.description: Hard copy of the information found

steps.response: If Yes, output spooled to printer. See Section 5.1.2 for outputs

steps.title: Step #51
steps.response: Exit search mode

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: PLEASE ENTER THE INPUT DATE AND COUNT CODE OF THE DOCUMENT

input.description: Input date and daily counter code of the document (input date 6 characters - MMDDYY, daily counter 4 characters, Figure 3)

steps.title: Step #2
prompt: WHICH SUBFILE IS THIS DOCUMENT LOCATED:

input.description: Enter number X of subfile 1 thru 6

steps.title: Step #3
steps.response: Pause for system housekeeping to be completed. Exit ARCHIVE mode when done. A pause of 15 to 50 seconds occurs for the system to update all files involved; when the document has been archived, the user is automatically returned to the program entry, section 2.2.
